planButton.title: Plan this recipe
planButton.body: Add it to a day in your weekly plan.

edit.title: Edit your plan
edit.body: Move meals, stretch them over several days or add your own items.

grip.title: Drag to move
grip.body: Hold and drag a meal to another day.

span.title: Cooking in batches?
span.body: Stretch a meal over multiple days.

add.title: Add anything
add.body: Search a recipe or type your own item, like “rice” or “eating out”.

slot.title: Move meals
slot.body: Drag a meal to another day.

resize.title: Cooking in batches?
resize.body: Drag the edge to stretch a meal over multiple days.

add.title: Add anything
add.body: Add a recipe or your own item, like “rice” or “eating out”.

itemName.title: Adjust items
itemName.body: Tap an item to change its name or quantity.

portions.title: Cooking for more people?
portions.body: Change the portions and the quantities follow.

copy.title: Use your own shopping app?
copy.body: Copy the list and paste it there.

add.title: Or shop right here
add.body: Tick items off as they go into the cart. Add anything else below.
